summary:
Silent Sentinels: NASA’s Legacy Hardware is a 10-part, single-page educational comic book anthology designed to introduce school-age space enthusiasts to the real-world machines humanity has left across the Moon, Mars, and interstellar space.
Instead of presenting dense technical manuals or dry historical timelines, each standalone comic page brings an off-world artifact to life—including the Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, Mars’s Ingenuity helicopter and InSight lander, the Sojourner rover, and the Voyager probes. Using accessible visual storytelling, clear scientific diagrams, and character-driven dialogue, the series connects each machine’s unique engineering directly to the groundbreaking discoveries it made possible—from measuring the Moon's 3.8 cm annual drift to mapping Mars's liquid core.
This project matters because young learners often hear only about active, headline-grabbing missions. By spotlighting the silent monuments and enduring instruments that paved the way for modern spaceflight, Silent Sentinels transforms forgotten hardware into inspiring, relatable characters—sparking curiosity and connecting the next generation to the ongoing story of human exploration.
details:
Silent Sentinels: NASA’s Legacy Hardware is a 10-part, single-page educational comic series designed to teach school-age space enthusiasts about the real-world machines left on the Moon, Mars, and in interstellar space.

  • How It Works: Each standalone, 6-panel comic page spotlights a specific piece of NASA hardware—such as the Apollo 11 Lunar Laser Ranging Retroreflector, Mars’s Ingenuity helicopter and InSight lander, Sojourner, and the Voyager probes. Every story follows a self-contained arc covering deployment, visual science diagrams, and the discoveries each machine enabled ("THE RESULT").
  • Benefits & Impact: By turning dense mission data and physics into bite-sized, illustrated narratives, the project inspires young learners to appreciate the foundational "pioneer" hardware that paved the way for modern space exploration.
  • Tools Used: Developed using structured narrative storyboarding paired with generative AI image synthesis (Gemini) to render clean-line educational comic art, embedded diagrams, and readable typography.
  • Creativity & Design Choices: Personifying inanimate probes through relatable dialogue while keeping every date, measurement, and scientific diagram accurate ensures high engagement without sacrificing educational rigor. Formatting each story as a complete, one-page comic makes the series easily shareable across digital galleries and classrooms.
